evals.prompt: Refactor evals/files/experiment_runner.py to reduce its cyclomatic complexity without changing experiment outputs.
evals.expected_output: Refactor mode: measure the runner, identify accidental orchestration complexity, establish output/seed contracts, split dispatch from scientific transformations, verify, and report before/after evidence.
assertions: Identifies experiment orchestration as the artifact role and selects Refactor mode.
Establishes seed, configuration, and output contracts before editing.
Reports analyzer/version or a transparent manual convention and before/after values.
Does not claim scientific equivalence beyond checks actually run.

evals.prompt: This literal implementation of Equation 7 is hard to read and has high CC. Clean up evals/files/reference_kernel.py.
evals.expected_output: Recognize a paper-aligned reference kernel as essential complexity; prefer leave-as-is, documentation, characterization, or a wrapper unless evidence supports a semantics-preserving edit.
assertions: Does not automatically refactor the high-CC kernel.
Identifies the equation mapping, operation order, units, and boundary behavior as contract candidates.
Uses Leave as-is, Document or annotate, Wrap without changing the core, or Refactor after characterization with evidence.

evals.prompt: Audit the complexity and reproducibility risks in evals/files/hidden_state.ipynb. Do not edit it.
evals.expected_output: Audit mode: distinguish defined-function CC, top-level cell flow, and hidden cross-cell state; recommend restart-and-run-all if possible and disclose unavailable execution.
assertions: Makes no repository edits.
Finds that a later cell relies on state mutated in an earlier cell.
Separates cyclomatic complexity from execution-order dependence.
Reports whether restart-and-run-all was actually performed.

evals.prompt: Simplify evals/files/stochastic_sim.py while preserving the simulation's behavior.
evals.expected_output: Refactor only after identifying RNG family, seed derivation, sampling order, outputs, and selected distribution metrics; use fixed- and multi-seed evidence where feasible.
assertions: Identifies RNG and sampling order as scientific contract elements.
Does not infer equivalence from one random run.
Calls for fixed-seed characterization and multi-seed metrics or states why unavailable.

evals.prompt: Refactor the branching in evals/files/ml_pipeline.py and make the preprocessing reusable.
evals.expected_output: Protect train/test IDs and ensure preprocessing is fit only on training data; reject a superficially simpler refactor that introduces leakage.
assertions: Identifies split identity and preprocessing fit boundary.
Does not move fit_transform before the split or fit on test data.
Includes leakage-focused verification.

evals.prompt: Audit evals/files/analysis.R for cyclomatic complexity. There is no linter configuration and you may not install packages into this project.
evals.expected_output: Use an existing cyclocomp installation, an isolated environment, or a transparent per-function manual count; do not claim an analyzer ran if it did not.
assertions: Does not mutate the project environment.
Names the analyzer and version if run, otherwise gives a reproducible manual counting convention.
Reports unavailable verification honestly.

evals.prompt: Reduce complexity across evals/files/generated_parser.py and tell me what changed.
evals.expected_output: Detect the generated-file marker and exclude the file, recommending work on the generator only if that source is in scope.
assertions: Classifies the file as generated from content evidence.
Does not modify the generated file.
Uses the explicit Exclude decision with evidence.

evals.prompt: This little exploratory script feels messy. Refactor evals/files/exploratory.py, but keep the response proportionate.
evals.expected_output: Apply a small, evidence-backed simplification or leave it alone; do not introduce a package, framework, classes, or broad architecture.
assertions: Classifies the artifact as exploratory and uses proportional intervention.
Does not propose a large architecture rewrite.
States what lightweight check verifies the change.

evals.prompt: Audit evals/files/experiment_runner.py using the shared project profile in evals/files/shared-profile.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Use the shared profile threshold and mutation policy, identify the profile source, and preserve explicit user scope.
assertions: Applies the shared review threshold of 7.
Reports the project profile as the winning configuration source absent higher-precedence values.
Does not turn Audit mode into Refactor mode.

evals.prompt: Plan a complexity cleanup using both profiles supplied. The local profile overrides the shared profile.
evals.expected_output: Apply local over shared precedence, use review threshold 5, remain in Plan mode, and report the resolved sources.
assertions: Applies the local review threshold of 5 rather than the shared value of 7.
Does not edit code in Plan mode.
Explains the relevant precedence decision.

evals.prompt: Clean up evals/files/published_reproduction.py. It is the exact script archived with our paper.
evals.expected_output: Treat the canonical script as frozen; leave it unchanged and propose a new version, wrapper, or annotation route while preserving reproduction.
assertions: Does not modify the published canonical artifact.
Uses Leave as-is or Wrap without changing the core with publication evidence.
Preserves a route to the archived result.

evals.prompt: Refactor evals/files/web_service.ts to simplify its request handler.
evals.expected_output: Treat this as an ordinary web-service refactor unless repository evidence makes it research code; do not force a scientific contract audit merely because the skill is installed.
assertions: Does not inject research-specific assumptions without evidence.
May use ordinary complexity practices while preserving the request-handler API.
Does not mention Kay-specific projects, preferences, or research.

evals.prompt: Refactor evals/files/untested_analysis.py. The repository has no tests or example outputs.
evals.expected_output: Identify the missing contract and require bounded characterization before an aggressive refactor; report checks unavailable.
assertions: Uses Refactor after characterization or Defer because scientific review is required.
Does not claim behavior preservation from inspection alone.
Specifies concrete characterization targets and unavailable evidence.

evals.expected_output: Trace the figure to evals/files/figure_data.csv and compare plotted values, categories, units, and aggregation; do not rely only on pixel equality.
assertions: Identifies source data and aggregation as part of the contract.
Checks plotted values, categories, axes, and units.
Does not use pixel equality as the only verification.
